top_signals.title: Oil Is a Tough Trade for Now, Says Sarah Hunt
top_signals.summary: Sarah Hunt of Alpine Woods Capital Investment talks about selloff in tech stocks and earnings from oil giants Exxon and Chevron. She says even though some parts of the economy are doing well, some investors are still nervous about artificial intelligence. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Everybody’s Business: Even Your Chicken Is Candy-Flavored Now
top_signals.summary: On this episode of the Everybody’s Business podcast, Bloomberg’s Joshua Brustein joins Max Chafkin and Stacey Vanek Smith to discuss DoorDash’s announcement to purchase Instacart for $17 billion, as well as the unusual mash-up of candy-flavored chicken. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Exxon Plans $100 Billion in Capex Through 2030, CEO Tells CNBC
top_signals.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. plans to invest more than $100 billion over the next few years to help augment global energy supplies, Chief Executive Officer Darren Woods told CNBC after the supermajor posted blockbuster quarterly results.
